skill.name: higgsfield-soul-id
skill.description: Guides Higgsfield Soul Character training using face photos, CLI authentication, model selection, status waiting, and reuse in image or video generation.
skill.summary: Train reusable Higgsfield Soul identities for face-faithful image and video generation.
skill.author: higgsfield-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown false positives from inline code, model names, or product-specific Soul reference commands. The remote installer command is a confirmed critical risk, and the workflow also handles biometric face photos that require explicit user consent.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to the shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl to sh with a package manager install, or download the installer, verify checksum or signature, and ask for confirmation before execution.

remediation.issue: The skill can install, authenticate, upload photos, and create remote identity models.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before each network operation and show the account, destination service, and files that will be uploaded.

remediation.issue: Soul training uses sensitive face photos and creates reusable identity references.
remediation.suggestion: Add consent, data retention, deletion, and authorized-subject guidance before collecting or uploading any face images.

remediation.issue: Command examples depend on user-supplied names, paths, and prompts.
remediation.suggestion: Quote user-supplied values, reject shell metacharacters where possible, and avoid constructing commands through raw shell interpolation.

content.value_statement: Identity-consistent media needs reusable face references. This skill guides Higgsfield Soul training, photo preparation, status checks, and downstream generation.
actual_capabilities: Explains when Soul training is appropriate for identity-faithful media.
Collects a Soul name and 5 to 20 face photo paths or upload IDs.
Chooses between Soul 2 and Soul Cinematic variants.
Runs Higgsfield CLI commands to create and wait for a Soul reference.
Shows how to reuse the trained Soul in image or cinematic generation.
limitations: Requires an authenticated Higgsfield CLI session.
Requires a paid Higgsfield plan for Soul training.
Uploads face photos to Higgsfield for model training.
Not intended for one-shot face swaps or non-photo character prompts.

output_examples.input: I have ten portraits for Ava and want consistent profile images.
output_examples.output: The photo set is suitable. I will train Soul Ava after your confirmation and report when it is ready.

output_examples.input: My training failed with a photo quality error.
output_examples.output: Replace group photos, sunglasses, repeated poses, and low-resolution images. Use at least five clear single-person face photos.

output_examples.input: Use my trained identity for a cinematic clip.
output_examples.output: I will select the cinematic Soul variant and prepare a generation prompt that keeps identity consistent across the scene.

best_practices: Confirm consent before uploading any face photo.
Use 8 to 12 varied, clear, single-person images.
Keep Soul reference IDs private unless the user asks to share them.
anti_patterns: Do not train on group photos or images with hidden faces.
Do not use this workflow for one-shot face swaps.
Do not run remote installers without review and user confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a Higgsfield Soul reference for identity-faithful image or video generation.

faq.question: How many photos are needed?
faq.answer: The workflow expects 5 to 20 face photos. Eight to twelve varied images are usually better.

faq.question: Does it require a paid account?
faq.answer: Yes. Soul training requires a paid Higgsfield plan and an authenticated CLI session.

faq.question: Can it train from group photos?
faq.answer: No. Use clear photos with one person, visible eyes, and minimal occlusion.

faq.question: Where are photos processed?
faq.answer: The Higgsfield CLI uploads selected photos to Higgsfield for Soul training.

faq.question: Can the Soul be reused later?
faq.answer: Yes. The trained reference can be reused in supported Higgsfield image and cinematic generation workflows.
